tools.name: ask
tools.title: Ask the Secretary
tools.description: Send a natural-language question to the user's personal secretary agent (Claude, running on the user's always-on Mac called `air`). The secretary has access to the user's: Obsidian vault (notes, projects, friends, recipes, wishlist, places, briefs/debriefs); Gmail (read + draft only — cannot send); Google Calendar (read + own-events write); Apple Reminders (create/list/update/complete — no hard delete); web search/fetch; conversation memory across past sessions; and the user's laptop Documents folder via Google Drive stream-mode. Use this tool whenever you need information that lives in the user's personal context — their schedule, email, notes, contacts, files, or anything they would normally ask a personal assistant. Returns plain-text reply, may be long.

question.description: The natural-language question or instruction to send to the secretary. May be long.
